neighbours.label: The speaker's licence to assert a claim: 'can (honestly) say' and 'the same cannot be said for', vs 'can' of ability and plain 'said'
fire: Having lived in five countries, I can honestly say this town is the friendliest.
The first film was a classic, but the same cannot be said of the remake.
After testing it for a month, we can say with confidence that the battery lasts.
The old bridge survived the flood; the same cannot be said for the road.
Looking back, I can truthfully say that I never regretted the move.
Our volunteers worked hard, and I can say without doubt that it paid off.
The hotel was spotless, which is more than can be said for the airport.
After ten years in the job, she can honestly say she still enjoys it.
quiet: Having lived in five countries, I believe this town is the friendliest.
The first film was a classic, but the remake was a flop.
After testing it for a month, we found that the battery lasts.
The old bridge survived the flood, but the road was washed away.
Looking back, she said that she never regretted the move.
Our volunteers worked hard, and they can lift heavy boxes without help.
The hotel was spotless, and so was the airport.
After ten years in the job, she can type faster than anyone.

predictions: 'I can honestly say', 'can say with certainty', 'the same cannot be said of' 0.5-0.75; 'can' of physical ability, reported 'said', 'I think' under 0.06.
notes: Card: ' can' x11, ' say' x9, ' be' x6 in 'more than can be said', 'I can honestly say', 'The same cannot be said'. Probe: cannot be said for 0.728, can honestly say 0.690, can say with pride 0.533; I think 0.049, can swim 0.059, They said 0.004, can open the window 0.002.
